component.name: Card
component.script: sub init() print "init width=";m.top.width;" mirror=";m.top.mirror;" caption=";FormatJSON(m.top.caption);" point=";FormatJSON(m.top.point) m.top.observeField("width","observed") m.top.findNode("box").observeField("width","childChanged") end sub sub widthChanged(event as object) print "width=";event.getData();" live=";m.top.width;" field=";event.getField();" node=";event.getRoSGNode().subtype();" id=";event.getNode() if m.top.width=90 then m.top.findNode("box").width=30 end sub sub mirrorChanged(event as object) print "mirror=";event.getData();" live=";m.top.mirror;" field=";event.getField();" node=";event.getRoSGNode().subtype();" id=";event.getNode() end sub sub observed(event as object) print "observed=";event.getData();" live=";m.top.width;" field=";event.getField();" node=";event.getRoSGNode().subtype();" id=";event.getNode() end sub sub childChanged(event as object) print "child=";event.getData();" parent=";m.top.width;" field=";event.getField();" node=";event.getRoSGNode().subtype();" id=";event.getNode() end sub
